sections.staging: STAGING CONTEXT: the OPENING HOOK of the song 'Put N Work'. The hook states the song's world -- no sleep, no peace, work as survival. This exact 11-line hook returns twice more later in the song (each return is its own fresh block). IMPORTANT, read carefully: there is NO redlight-motif line anywhere in this song -- no line brakes, stops, or pulls up at a light (the one cops line, much later in the song, runs FROM them). So redlight is false on every line, no line may claim the motif scatter, and every hero lands plain.
